name: @jamesai/content-production-mcp

tools.name: validate_style
tools.description: Validate Chinese text against writing style rules. Checks forbidden words, punctuation (em dash, double quotes, narrative colons), emoji, CJK-English spacing, and consecutive parallelism. Returns structured JSON with violations.

allow_emoji.description: Allow emoji (e.g. for Xiaohongshu). Default: false

tools.name: generate_brief
tools.description: Generate a writing brief template for article creation. The brief must be confirmed before writing begins.

mode.description: Writing mode: quick (casual, skip fact-check), deep (default), research (fact-heavy, mandatory fact-check)

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List all available brand persona configurations. Shows bundled examples and user-added brands in brands/examples/.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: Retrieve a specific methodology section by key. Use this to load methodology content into context for writing tasks. Available sections: core (Core 4D Methodology), philosophy (Philosophy Weapons), style-rules (Writing Style Rules), rlhf (RLHF Self-Evolution System), platforms (Platform Formatting Rules), emotional-narrative (Emotional Narrative Framework), argumentation (Argumentation Tactics), reconstruction (Material Reconstruction), creator-mindset (Creator Mindset), content-map (Content Map), methodology (Tension-Resonance Method), interdisciplinary (Interdisciplinary Weapons), topic-analysis (Topic Analysis Theory Arsenal)

tools.name: get_platform_rules
tools.description: Get detailed formatting and publishing rules for a specific platform (WeChat, Xiaohongshu, X Articles CN/EN, LinkedIn).
